label: first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx 1), sparse subset
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase, at the step right after the first output: input is orig(0), output is orig(1) (recall_idx 1). That step holds 87% of activation mass and every top example. A weaker tail at recall_idx 2 (11%) and 3 (1%). Never fires in the original phase or on <DEL>. But only about 22% of recall_idx==1 steps are active, and no simple variable picks them out. Firing and magnitude are higher for L 5-6 than for L 8-9, when the last original tokens are z/0/e, when the sequence has z/0/3, and when orig(1) is t/v/3/u. Each of these alone only gets precision 0.3-0.45 and loses a lot of recall. So the description is positional with unexplained gating on content.
